articles.title: Could Aliens Have Brains Made of Crystal? A Philosopher Says Maybe!
articles.summary: What if a thinking mind didn't need a human brain? A philosopher says consciousness might exist in totally weird materials—like crystal or mercury. The universe has a trillion galaxies, so the chances are huge.

articles.title: Fire in a Cave 1.8 Million Years Ago? Early Humans Were Smarter Than We Thought!
articles.summary: Scientists found burned bones deep inside a South African cave—far from any wildfire. This means early humans were carrying fire inside and keeping it burning nearly 1.8 million years ago. That's way earlier than we knew!

articles.title: This Butterfly Lives Almost a Year—and Barely Ages!
articles.summary: Most butterflies live only weeks, but the Heliconius butterfly can survive nearly a year. Scientists found one species that shows almost no signs of getting old—its grip strength stays strong. They think pollen-eating might be the secret.
